description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which serves as the main screen for an Android TV app. It includes setup for hero banner carousel, continue watching section, and TV channels rail, with focus management and auto-scroll logic. It integrates Jetpack Compose for the top navigation bar and handles data loading via ViewModel and repositories.
external_methods: Fragment's lifecycle methods onCreate, onCreateView, onViewCreated, onResume, onPause

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the home screen, managing UI components, focus, auto-scrolling hero carousel, and data binding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the repository and ViewModel.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Sets up the root view hierarchy, including composing the top nav bar, hero banner, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus and observes ViewModel LiveData for data updates.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restarts hero auto-scrolling when the fragment becomes active.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops hero auto-scrolling when fragment is paused.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Sets up observers for LiveData to update UI based on data loading state.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays error message with a retry prompt.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates the continue watching rail with fetched data and manages focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds a Jetpack Compose-based top navigation bar with focus and key handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures the hero carousel with auto-scroll, focus management, and peeking layout.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers a hero card in the viewport with peeking on sides.

methods.name: pauseAutoScrollForUserInteraction
methods.description: Pauses automatic hero carousel scrolling upon user interaction.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Starts or resumes auto-scrolling of hero carousel.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops hero auto-scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Creates the UI for the Continue Watching list.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Creates the UI for the TV Channels list.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus on the content rails based on user interaction state.

methods.name: dpToPx
